name: Ecosystem Aquarium
description: Set fish, snails, plants, light and food, then run the days and watch oxygen, algae and the food chain.

about.concept: Feedback loops and balance. Fish, snails, plants, light and food all affect oxygen, algae and each other; the child changes one thing, runs the days, and reads what happened.
about.progression: The first tanks balance with one or two changes. Later tanks have more species and tighter limits, and the child is asked to keep a tank healthy for longer runs and to explain a crash.
